configure_mask_rcnn_with_regnetx_backbon: configure a Mask R-CNN model to use a RegNetX-4GF backbone for COCO instance segmentation
set_regnet_backbone_parameters: set RegNet backbone parameters including depth, width, and group width for the model
configure_optimizer_weight_decay: configure the SGD optimizer weight decay to 5e-5 for training
set_init_checkpoint_url: set the initial checkpoint URL to a pre-trained RegNetX-4GF DDS model
enable_cudnn_benchmark: enable cudnn benchmark mode to improve training performance for RegNet models
